description: A sharper talking video from one portrait at 768p: send your own MP3 or WAV voice, or a script it speaks in one of 30 voices, up to 20 seconds. Compared with other video tools: mid-priced. Price: from $0.054 per second (one call: from $0.541 per video), charged only on success. Price depends on max_seconds: 10 $0.541, 20 $1.081 (default 10). With an account API key you pay only for what the call used (per second), never more than this price. One call = one short video.

audio.description: Your own speech as an MP3 or WAV URL; the video is as long as the audio. Use this or voice_script. Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)

image.description: Portrait of the person who speaks, the first frame (https URL, jpg, png or webp). Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)

max_seconds.description: Longest the video can be; sets the price. Longer audio or scripts are refused before anything runs, and not charged. Default 10

video_prompt.description: How the person looks and moves while speaking

voice_prompt.description: How to say it: tone, pace, accent

voice_script.description: Exact words to say, spoken by the chosen voice, when you send no audio (about 2.3 words a second)
